key_insight: Physics-aware verification can catch erroneous literature-mined material properties before they mislead AI discovery.
engineering_relevance: Screening extracted values using provenance, physical constraints, and statistical checks helps prevent AI searches from prioritizing false material candidates.
method: Classify extraction errors by origin and signature.
Layer schema, provenance, physical admissibility, and cross-source consensus checks.
Audit models and prioritize suspicious records for review.
evidence_signal: In a controlled benchmark, the combined framework detected 81% of errors at 85% precision and brought held-out model accuracy within 3% of a clean-data-trained model.
watch_item: Verification remains imperfect, and missing measurement conditions can make physically distinct records indistinguishable even after erroneous values are controlled.
paper_title: No Value Is Better Than a Wrong Value: Finding and Handling Erroneous Data in Literature-Mined Datasets for AI
